text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell?! Actually,
my banana diet craze has flared up again!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Don't just eat the banana!!
Drape it over your shoulder—that's my personal health method!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And after spending the day like that, look at me!
I'm ten thousand times more energized!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Whether her banana-based health regimen was legit or not, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi seemed to have enjoyed a wonderful day off.
